UserPushProfile.title: UserPushProfile
UserPushProfile.description: Authenticated user notification preferences, FCM registration token, and worship sync metadata

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user owning this document

fcmToken.description: Optional Firebase Cloud Messaging device registration token

cityName.description: Optional selected city name in Arabic

athanEnabled.description: Whether prayer notification alerts are enabled

athkarAutoEnabled.description: Whether automatic morning and evening Athkar playback is enabled

subscribedTopics.description: List of subscribed FCM notification topics

qadaRemaining.description: Remaining fasting days to make up

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

BroadcastReminder.title: BroadcastReminder
BroadcastReminder.description: Admin-managed pinned or temporary audio/text reminder pushed immediately, at a scheduled time, or repeating daily to app users

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who published the reminder

title.description: Arabic display title of the reminder

body.description: Optional message body or dhikr text

reminderKind.description: Whether this is a text notification or an audio reminder

persistenceMode.description: Whether the reminder stays pinned in the app or expires automatically

deliveryMode.description: Trigger immediately, at a single scheduled time, or daily repeating

audioUrl.description: Original https audio URL pasted in the admin portal

normalizedAudioUrl.description: Direct playable https audio URL resolved from Drive/Dropbox/direct audio link

audioSourceType.description: Detected audio format or provider label

isActive.description: Whether this reminder is currently active on user devices

triggerNonce.description: Monotonic trigger counter incremented on immediate re-push

expiresAtMillis.description: Optional UTC epoch milliseconds when a temporary reminder expires

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user push notification registration and worship preferences

/broadcast_reminders/{reminderId}.description: Admin-managed remote text and audio reminders synchronized to the app
